evolution.factory_default_note: In kithna-species.ts, lowform, highform, and legion currently default to the hatchling because no later forms have been defined yet.

species_locked_facts: Magmado are a wild Kithna species.
Magmado currently appear during the night in Kithna.
Magmado currently use the balanced Kithna egg stat spread.

identity.individuality_rule: Two Magmado of the same species are not required to share personality, temperament, affection style, social behavior, preferences, fears, habits, or reactions.

personality.behavior_rule: Personality rolls change how this individual Magmado expresses an intent. They do not change the underlying biological need.

preference_discovery.discovery_rule: Repeated experiences gradually establish the individual Magmado's preferences rather than assigning universal species favorites.

care_willingness.rule: High bond can increase trust and willingness, but does not force an individual Magmado to become cheerful, social, affectionate, energetic, or obedient.

player_skill_decisions.replacement_semantics: Future approved milestones only: preserve existing animation timing; show four eligible skill names/descriptions, never role labels; select and confirm one. Validate ownership, eligibility and retry identity to prevent duplicate learning/rewards. Replacement must respect authoritative learned capacity, explicitly confirm the old skill and commit atomically. Four local equipped slots do not establish learned capacity. Cancel/failure preserves old skills; unselected skills are not learned. No UI or persistence activated.
